span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Choosing an inhibitory (PV) opsin-expressing cell reverses the sign of the expected synaptic side-effect, so any blue-light-driven rate increase in the tagged cell must come from direct illumination rather than from trans-synaptic drive
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Optically driven PV cells inhibit their postsynaptic pyramidal partners, so activating the PV cell lowers pyramidal firing and silencing it raises pyramidal firing
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: With excitatory-cell expression, a non-illuminated opsin-free neuron may inherit a rate increase or decrease through glutamatergic connections from directly illuminated pre-synaptic neurons - which is why the inhibitory-cell design reverses the sign and makes the inference possible.
span.term: a recorded neuron can inherit a rate change it never received light for
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Each dual-color unit takes about six hours of manual assembly.
span.note: what this limits: any plan to build these at scale: ASSEMBLING A SINGLE DUAL-COLOR OPTICAL UNIT REQUIRES ABOUT SIX HOURS OF WORK
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Unit weight over 0.5 g caps how many can be mounted on a small animal.
span.note: what this limits: how many units a small animal can carry: EACH UNIT WEIGHS OVER 0.5 g
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Only a fraction of PV interneurons expressed both opsins, so not all blue-responsive cells were also red-responsive.
span.note: what this limits: the bidirectional control claim for the population: A THIRD LIMITING FACTOR IS THE PERCENTAGE OF PV INTERNEURONS WITH DOUBLE EXPRESSION OF BOTH CaMKII AND JAWS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The inference from a rate increase to direct illumination carries a named exception, and it is stated inside the sentence the conclusion is drawn from.
span.note: what this limits: reading a light-evoked rate increase in an inhibitory cell as direct activation: the paper states this holds with the caveat of disynaptic dis-inhibition
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The design space is bounded by what is commercially available and by the physical envelope, not by what the experiment would ideally need.
span.note: what this limits: the wavelengths and powers available in this device: the diodes were chosen to fit a 3.8 mm can, a 100 mA maximal current limitation and low threshold currents
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The design space was bounded by the model before it was bounded by experiment: butt-coupling was excluded on modelled grounds, so the reported geometry is the survivor of a simulated elimination rather than a measured comparison.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The simple astigmatic Gaussian beam model, a solution of the paraxial Helmholtz equation from laser-beam physics, is imported to predict coupling efficiency and set the optical pathway lengths of the implantable neural device.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a baseline recording period of at least 15 minutes preceding photostimulation in every session
span.note: eliminates: that the spiking and LFP changes attributed to photostimulation were already present before the light was applied · outcome: held

span.label: extends → previous demonstrations of activating and silencing the same neuron in brain slices, a head-fixed mouse and a freely-moving rat (references [8], [26], [16], [15])
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: rate increase —distinct-from→ disynaptic dis-inhibition
span.note: strength of the relation: 0.9 — THE PAPER NAMES THE CONFOUND IN THE SENTENCE THAT MAKES THE INFERENCE. Choosing an INHIBITORY cell reverses the expected synaptic sign, so a rate increase after blue light can only be direct illumination - 'with the caveat of disynaptic dis-inhibition'. The design turns a confound into a signature, and the one route that survives is stated in the same breath rather than left to a reader.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: rate increase —operationalised-as→ ChR2
span.note: differs in: PULSE DURATION DECIDES WHICH DIRECTION COUNTS AS EVIDENCE: a rate increase during 50 ms pulses and a rate DECREASE during 200 ms pulses both tag a cell as PV. The same cell class is identified by opposite signs of the same measure, separated only by how long the light was on · strength of the relation: 0.8
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: predictive model —operationalised-as→ laser diode
span.note: strength of the relation: 0.8 — FEASIBILITY WAS SETTLED BEFORE ANYTHING WAS BUILT, and the model's job was to RULE DESIGNS OUT: it 'indicated that a butt-coupling solution cannot be extrapolated to the dual-source case simply by angling one or both of the diodes'. The published device is what survived a modelled elimination.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The lens-free dual-color unit delivered 454±271 µW of 450 nm light and 8.65±2.26 mW of 638 nm light at the fiber tip at 100 mA, far above the 100 µW / 1 mW design thresholds.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The blue and red illumination fields emerging from the shared multimode fiber overlapped spatially by 46%, a lower bound on the in-brain overlap.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The two wavelengths did not interact optically: their spectra at the fiber end were separate and no spectral interference occurred during simultaneous dual-color illumination.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Nine of 74 interneurons (12%) were controlled bidirectionally through the same fiber, raising their spike rate under blue light and lowering it under red light.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Blue-light activation produced significantly larger effects than red-light silencing, which the authors attribute to less red light being applied or weaker expression of the red-sensitive opsin.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The second-order effects on pyramidal cells were strictly sign-appropriate for inhibition: no pyramidal cell was excited by blue light and none was suppressed by red light.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: On the freely-moving mouse's head the laser can heated by no more than 7 °C even under prolonged pulsed illumination.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Wide-band recordings taken during both blue and red illumination were free of electromagnetic-interference artifacts, so the shielding and grounding worked at the power levels used.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The paper claims the first conclusive demonstration that a single identified neuron can be both activated and silenced in a freely-moving animal.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The approach's main cost is labour: each dual-color optical unit takes roughly six hours to assemble.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
